post.title: Headphones In on the Train? Science Says Try This #shorts
post.description: Would you say hi first? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend with noise-cancelling everything. Lila rides the morning train with headphones in and eyes down, while The Doubt whispers that talking to a stranger would be awkward. In 'Mistakenly Seeking Solitude' (Journal of Experimental Psychology: General, 2014), Nicholas Epley and Juliana Schroeder asked Chicago commuters on trains and buses to either strike up a conversation with a stranger, sit in solitude, or ride as usual. The people who talked reported a more pleasant commute, even though commuters predicted the opposite: they expected connecting to be the worse experience and assumed others wouldn't want to talk. We underestimate how much other people want to connect too. You don't have to chat every day, but one 'good book?' might beat another podcast. #psychology #shorts #socialanxiety #overthinking #happiness
